phrases: These two services can't finish starting.
Spring starts Service A, whose constructor needs Service B.
But Service B needs Service A first. The arguments must exist before construction. Neither constructor can finish.
Startup fails with a bean currently in creation exception. This is a constructor cycle.
Refactor the collaboration. An orchestration service calls A and B; they no longer depend on each other.
Our tests confirm failure before, and successful startup after. Other circular references behave differently. Redesign the dependency graph.
